notes: *along* rides inside παράγων's unit under rule 106: παρά has its own full English word *by*, so nothing of the preposition's own rendering is taken from it, unlike an ἐκ that requires *out of*.
*casting a net* is kept as one unit on ἀμφιβάλλοντας, the supplied object completing the verb's own English, headed on the verb word.
